items.title: Japanese beer giant Asahi says data breach hit 1.5 million people
items.description: Asahi Group Holdings, Japan's largest beer producer, has finished the investigation into the September cyberattack and found that the incident has impacted up to 1.9 million individuals. [...]

items.title: CISA Warns of OpenPLC ScadaBR cross-site scripting vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has officially updated its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog to include a critical flaw in OpenPLC ScadaBR, confirming that threat actors are actively weaponizing it in the wild. The security defect, identified as CVE-2021-26829, is a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability rooted in the system_settings.shtm component of…
